report.title: Evaluating Autonomous Adoption and Economic Sustainability in Multi-Agent Networks
report.summary: The deployment of autonomous economic agents within decentralized networks represents a fundamental evolution in market mechanism design. In these environments, software agents are tasked with executing counterpart discovery, negotiating terms, coordinating stateful tasks, and settling transactions…
